data.explanation: Your insurer needs more proof to process your household contents (Hausrat) water damage claim: a list of the damaged items, purchase receipts, and photos. Send these documents by the deadline shown. If you miss it, the insurer says it will decide the claim based only on the file as it currently stands (nach Aktenlage), which could mean a lower payout or rejection. There is no fee to pay here — just documents to gather and send. If you're missing some receipts, note this to the insurer or consider alternative proof (bank statements, warranty cards).
